mentions.name: AVShack
mentions.description: A Linux live streaming media server that supports ingesting, mixing with mix-minus, MultiMux, multistreaming, and recording of RTMP, RTSP, SRT, and MP4 streams, with LL-HLS, low-latency WebTransport, and low-latency WebSocket viewing.
